📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap`
This is occurrence #11 in the last 7 days (123 total since 2026-07-04; degraded-mode cycle, no live Slack alert to confirm against).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (runtime-core-subscriber-api) / `Admin` (mobile-notifications-stack) — split by service, DD tag says `team:crm` for both
Playbook: Confirm shape via dd_search.py metric sum:trace.amqp.command.hits{service:<name>,env:prod}.as_rate() over a multi-hour window — expect a genuine but brief dip below the monitor's floor, not a data gap/tool failure; confirm 0 error logs for the window; check sibling monitors in the family before escalating.
Open Jira: n/a

Source alerts (1 total):
  • n/a — degraded mode (no Slack MCP this session). Monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/302055141

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/302055141
  • DD metric: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.amqp.command.hits&exp_scope=service%3Amethod-mobile-notifications-subscriber%2Cenv%3Aprod&exp_agg=avg&start=1786773621&end=1786780821
  • Kibana: n/a — evidence_source is datadog_apm for this entry, not ES
  • This-window concentration: 0 error logs (service:method-mobile-notifications-subscriber status:error, 05:00:21–07:00:21Z); metric near baseline (0.067 msg/s vs ~0.06 documented baseline) by fire time

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring`
This is occurrence #3 in the last 7 days (262 total since 2026-05-23; first fire in ~5 days — entry had been quiet since 2026-08-10).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Vertical App Experience`
Playbook: Confirm pattern via dd_search.py metric p95:trace.aspnet_core.request{env:prod,service:runtime-core-api,resource_name:post_/api/v1/runtime/load/_screenid*} — cluster of >3s points in window confirms shape; confirm latency-only via 0 error logs; inspect outlier APM traces for the slow span (SQL/Mongo/Redis) if escalating further.
Open Jira: n/a

Source alerts (1 total):
  • n/a — degraded mode (no Slack MCP this session). Monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/115456700

Evidence:
